behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; fields read: qword at [rdi+0x8], qword at [rdi+0x10], qword at [rdi+0x20] (pop path only), qword at [rdi+0x20]-8 (pop path only), counter qword at [rdi+0x28]. No other argument register is read.
behavior.comparison: The gate is a qword equality compare (cmp + je). All arithmetic wraps at 64 bits; the tag math is lea 0x200(%rdx) followed by sub $0x20, so the stored +0x8 pointer is val+0x1e0 while the stored +0x18 slot is val+0x200.
behavior.entry_shape: Two-path helper with one forward branch (je to the pop path) and two ret instructions; no loop, no call opcode at any instruction start inside the window.
behavior.return_rule: Both paths return rax = the new [rdi+0x8] value: val+0x1e0 on the pop path, [rdi+0x8]-0x20 on the else path. The return value is observed from the retained bytes (rax holds the stored value at each ret); no caller use of it is claimed.

caller_fdes.note: Site confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from the caller FDE start; caller setup immediately before the call is lea 0x228(%rdi),%rdi; caller purpose not claimed.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; the site was additionally confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.

scout_corrections: The round-12 scout note listed this window (ranked #2) with FDE [0x5178be0, 0x5178c37), 87 bytes, 9 padding bytes, one direct caller boundary-confirmed, no naming relocation, and the pop path's distinctive 0x200 tag math. Every element verified exactly. No numeric correction to the scout's numbers was needed. One phrasing point is reconciled explicitly: the scout's 'zero calls' describes the window body (no call opcode at any instruction start inside it), while the one direct site is an incoming call from one caller FDE — the two statements are about different directions and do not conflict.
